description: "Essay on the effects of iodine on the human constitution" by William Gairdner is a scientific publication written in the early 19th century. This book explores the medicinal properties of iodine, particularly its applications and effects concerning various diseases, including bronchocele, scrofula, and tuberculous conditions affecting the chest and abdomen.
